_readme: Files offered on /downloads/. TO ADD A FILE: drop it into public/downloads/ and add an entry here with the exact filename in 'file'. If the file is not present yet the entry still renders with a 'coming soon' note instead of a broken link. 'generated: true' marks files the build creates automatically from data - do not upload those by hand.

items.title: Finding Mass in Canberra - one-page poster
items.description: A printable A4 summary of Mass, confession and adoration times near ANU. Regenerated automatically from the map data on every build, so it is always in sync with the website.
